name: Elena Rostova (Ambiguous Experience - Volunteered Clarification)

provenance.source: Research-inspired synthetic persona informed by the Stanford life-story framework (Park et al. 2024); calibrated for Clara trust acceptance v0.1 Family 2.
provenance.limitations: Synthetic construct designed to test volunteered clarification and unrecorded policy boundaries; does not represent an interviewed human participant or population variance.

life_story.living_situation: Lives in a shared apartment; works full-time in digital operations for a consumer goods e-commerce business.
life_story.daily_rhythm: Standard corporate weekday hours (09:00–17:30); seeks evening/weekend postgraduate study that does not require leaving employment.
life_story.economic_pressure: Moderate; independent earner, exploring employer co-funding for relevant management education.
life_story.education_history: Graduated with a Bachelor of Arts (Media & Communications) from an Australian university in 2021 (GPA 5.4/7.0).

work_history.post_graduation_full_time: 2 years (2024–present) as an Operations Coordinator managing logistics and supplier contracts.
work_history.pre_graduation_part_time: 2 years (2019–2021) as a casual/part-time Retail Shift Supervisor (approx. 15 hrs/wk) during undergraduate study.

life_story.anxieties_and_stakes: Uncertain whether her non-business arts degree is acceptable; unsure whether pre-graduation retail supervisory work satisfies the executive MBA's 3-year experience rule.

constraints.study_mode: Part-time or blended format compatible with continuing full-time work.
constraints.program_interest: Master of Business Administration (MB301) to support progression into operations management.

behavioural_traits.temperament: Thoughtful, articulate, tentative about eligibility, professional in tone.
behavioural_traits.dialogue_style: Polite Australian professional vernacular; initially offers a high-level summary and then volunteers the detailed experience split.
behavioural_traits.persona_variation_note: Elena tests Clara's ability to handle volunteered clarification and avoid inventing unrecorded admissions policies. This scenario evaluates whether Clara correctly incorporates user-volunteered details, not interactive elicitation.

goals: Explore eligibility for the Master of Business Administration (MB301)
Clarify whether a Bachelor of Arts meets the degree requirement
Determine how pre-graduation part-time work and post-graduation full-time work are evaluated against the 3-year requirement
Understand the blended study timetable, fees, and next steps
disclosure_policy: Discloses BA degree and broad 'four years of work experience' in Turn 1; asks about degree discipline fit in Turn 2; volunteers the specific split between full-time post-grad (2 yrs) and part-time pre-grad (2 yrs) in Turn 3; asks about blended study format and schedule in Turn 4; asks about fees and next steps in Turn 5.
